cat > /tmp/x.py 2>/dev/null; cat > "$TMPDIR/fix.py" <<'E'
import re,glob
M={'report':'Report issue','exportData':'Export data','edit':'Edit item','dismiss':'Dismiss item','reload':'Reload data','add':'Add item','find':'Search items','remove':'Remove item'}
n=0
for f in glob.glob('src/**/*',recursive=True):
    if not f.endswith(('.ts','.html')): continue
    s=open(f).read()
    def r(m):
        global n
        t=m.group(0)
        if re.search(r'label',t): return t
        h=re.search(r'\(press\)="(\w+)\(',t)
        if not h: print('skip',f,t); return t
        n+=1
        return re.sub(r'(icon="\w+")',r'\1 label="%s"'%M[h.group(1)],t,1)
    s2=re.sub(r'<app-icon-button(?![\w-])[^>]*>',r,s)
    if s2!=s: open(f,'w').write(s2)
print(n)
E
